errors.evidence: The y-axis label is "Eval PPL.", which stands for Evaluation Perplexity. The description incorrectly expands this to "Perplexity Loss (PPL)".
The description states that the Transformer line has circular markers, but the figure shows a dashed line with no markers.
The description reports the PPL for the Transformer model as approximately 11.75, but the horizontal line in the plot is clearly lower, at approximately 11.6.
The description states the MoHD model begins at a PPL of approximately 11.15. The point on the graph is closer to 11.1.
